[[Vault-Tec Corporation]] |role =Vault dweller |TV actor =[[Sydney Olson]] |dod =July 2296 |dod verified=yes }} {{Quotation|I'm okay!|After falling down from her pod|sound=Executive assistant Im okay.ogg}} The '''executive assistant''' is a resident of [[Vault 31]] who appears in the [[Fallout TV series season 2|second season]] of the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]]. ==Background== This woman was a member of [[Bud's Buds]] who, like the other residents of [[Vault 31]], was [[Cryonics|cryonically]] frozen in [[Timeline (2050-2099)#2077|2077]] to be reactivated at a later time for use in the [[Three Vaults]]. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Golden Rule]]=== After [[Norm MacLean]] initiated a mass reactivation of Vault 31's dwellers, awakening them from their cryopods, the executive assistant fell from a great height while descending to the ground level. Though she screamed in terror on her way down and struck her head, the executive assistant quickly pulled herself up and assured the other Vault dwellers that she was okay. Later, while the dwellers were investigating the Vault's ventilation system as a potential means to escape to the surface, the executive assistant climbed a human ladder to reach a hatch. She released the hatch door, which opened with an outswing, striking her in the face. Despite the forceful impact of the hatch giving her a nosebleed, the executive assistant proudly announced that a ladder was just beyond the hatch, which eventually led to the surface.{{FOTV|2|2}} ===[[The Demon in the Snow]]=== {{section|FOTV}} ===[[The Wrangler]]=== {{section|FOTV}} ===[[The Handoff]]=== {{section|FOTV}} ===[[The Strip]]=== {{section|FOTV}} ==Personality== The executive assistant appears to be something of a klutz. Although she suffers injuries due to her clumsy nature, she maintains a cheery disposition. ==Appearances== The executive assistant appears only {{In|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|10=202|12=204|13=205|15=207|16=208}} ==Behind the scenes== The executive assistant is portrayed by [[Sydney Olson]], a stunt actor who auditioned for the role. She remarked that she found it easy to embody the role, joking that she herself is clumsy. Stunt coordinator [[Casey O'Neill]] and the show's rigging team directed the executive assistant's stunts, and collaborated to keep Olson safe during filming.[https://www.instagram.com/sydneyolson1/p/DSxwzyUEtns/?hl=en Sydney Olson on Instagram]: ''"Two of my scenes from episode 2 of Fallout. 😂 I auditioned for this part, and it's the part I was born to play. It’s easy to act when you are that character lol. #clumsy #imokay
Thank you @caseyoneillstunts and the excellent rigging team for keeping me safe! 🙏🏻"'' ==Gallery== FOTV executive assistant 02.png|"I'm okay!"
